answer: Cells must harbor distinct RF fingerprints, so each agent’s radio signature is verified against a link-budget atlas of pathloss and interference before admission. A fable of unlimited free identities collapses because spoofing many spatial signatures demands costly directional antennas and synchronized transmit power across separate physical locations. The limit: dense urban multipath can blur fingerprints, letting a well-funded attacker reuse one site for a few sybils.
